cases.name: Brittany Weston
cases.about: “Brittany always told everyone how beautiful New Hampshire is and how friendly the community of Troy is,” Shane Lampinen said during the eulogy. “She dedicated her life to being the best mother to her beloved little B,” Lampinen said.
cases.narrative: He shot her multiple times in the head.
